description:
NO ONWARD CHAIN! Ready to move into, this well-presented one-bedroom ground-floor apartment is situated in the popular Hamilton Court development in Blackpool, conveniently located close to a range of local shops, amenities and excellent transport links.

Benefiting from its own separate private entrance, the accommodation offers a spacious sitting/dining room, a generous double bedroom with modern fitted wardrobes, and a contemporary three-piece wet room. Further benefits include ample residential parking and the convenience of ground-floor living. An ideal purchase for first-time buyers, downsizers or buy-to-let investors, this property is offered with no onward chain and is ready for its new owner to move straight into. Early viewing is highly recommended.

Briefly comprising; entrance porch, hallway, sitting/dining room, kitchen, bedroom, shower room and residential parking. 

GROUND FLOOR

ENTRANCE PORCH
UPVC double glazed door to the side aspect. 

HALLWAY
Spacious hallway with two large storage cupboards, one which houses the water tank.

KITCHEN
2.71m x 2.30m (8'11 x 7'7)
UPVC double glazed window to the front rear aspect. Fitted kitchen with a range of wall and base units with complementary work surfaces, plumbed for washing machine, space for fridge/freezer, integrated oven and hob with extractor over, sink with mixer tap and tiled splash back.

SITTING/DINING ROOM 
5.03m x 3.64m (16'6 x 11'11)
UPVC double glazed window to the front aspect, feature electric fire, tv point and electric heater.

BEDROOM
3.88m x 3.66m (12'9 x 12'0)
UPVC double glazed window to the rear aspect, fitted wardrobes and electric heater.

SHOWER ROOM
2.08m x 1.0m (6'10 x 4'11)
Modern fitted three piece suite wet room comprising; shower attachment, wash basin and low flush wc. 

EXTERNAL
Residential parking. 

TENURE
We have been informed that the property is leasehold on a 999 year lease from built with a ground rent of £60 per annum and a service charge of £80 per calendar month; prospective purchasers should seek clarification of this from their solicitors.

VIEWINGS 
Viewings are strictly by appointment through the agents office.

All measurements are approximate and for illustrative purposes only. Digital images are reproduced for general information only and must not be inferred that any item shown is included for sale with the property. We have been unable to confirm if services / items in the property are in full working order. The property is offered for sale on this basis. Prospective purchasers are advised to seek expert advice where appropriate.
